content.thinking:
The reference model has a bug: it computes the initial certificate AFTER running the transactions (I appended `certificate(st, q0)` at the end using the final state). I need to capture the initial certificate before the transactions run. Let me fix ref.py: compute cert0 = certificate(st, q0) right after legality check.

Also the domains need verification — the ref uses its own domain functions; if they disagree with Rust, we'd see mismatches in group rows.

Fix ref.py.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='ref.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""        outs = []
        for revision, elist, tq in txs:""","""        cert0 = certificate(st, q0)
        outs = []
        for revision, elist, tq in txs:""")
s=s.replace("""        results.append({'nodes': n, 'templates': tcount, 'initial': certificate(st, q0),
                        'transactions': outs})""","""        results.append({'nodes': n, 'templates': tcount, 'initial': cert0, 'transactions': outs})""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 dev/compare.py 2>&1 | tail -12
